Salem Human Rights Coalition Values 
• We value and respect members of all communities. 
• We welcome people of every age, ancestry, color, disability, ethnicity, family status, gender identity or 
expression, immigration status, marital status, military status, national origin, race, religion, sex or 
sexual orientation. 
• We will create a brave space for all participants at SHRC meetings, whether in-person or online. 
• We will challenge the use of microaggressions* , and we will not tolerate abusive or bullying behavior. 
* Microaggressions are casual remarks, questions, or actions that are painful because they have to do with a 
person's membership in a group discriminated against or subject to stereotypes. 
We expect ALL participants to abide by SHRC values while attending the meeting, or risk expulsion.
